Name: Otto The Ottoman (As a Horse)
Author: TheDogtorWho
Description:
Based on Otto the Ottoman from the DechartGames Twitch streams! 

This mod replaces the sprite sheet of the horse in Stardew Valley. Features a run animation and a little animated heart when Otto is idle! <3
Just replace the horse.xnb file with the original in the StardewValley/Content/TileSheets folder. (Make sure to save a copy of the original file from the folder, just in case there's any issues and you need a back up of the original!)

Feel free to message if you have any questions or spot any issues! :)
